question: Should ClawHub adopt the RFC #27 experimental Claw v1 schema and storage contract now, before the remaining gated publication, discovery, and feed slices are accepted?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it establishes a durable cross-product registry contract and public package-family vocabulary; code review cannot decide whether that product direction has sufficient RFC sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor the staged experimental contract
options.body: Approve the storage-only foundation with publication still closed, then review the gated follow-on PRs as separate compatibility and security decisions.

options.title: Keep the stack draft pending RFC direction
options.body: Defer merging until a maintainer confirms the RFC contract and the intended compatibility/migration ownership.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged experimental contract
recommendation.body: Approve the storage-only foundation with publication still closed, then review the gated follow-on PRs as separate compatibility and security decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the submitted four-PR implementation stack and can provide the concrete RFC and compatibility context needed for a maintainer sponsorship decision.
